phrases.texte: In the reading section, you do not always know the answer. But you can remove the wrong ones.
Each wrong answer you remove raises your chances. With two answers left, you have a fifty percent chance.
And there is no penalty for a wrong answer. So always answer.
Use three filters, in this order. First, the form: is it the right type of word for the blank?
Second, the grammar: does it agree with the subject and the tense?
Third, the meaning: does the sentence make sense?
Let's try with a TOEIC question. The new policy will be, blank, next month.
A: implement. B: implementation. C: implemented. D: implementing.
phrases.dit: Answer A. implement. Answer B. implementation. Answer C. implemented. Answer D. implementing.

phrases.texte: Filter one, the form. After will be, a base verb is impossible. Remove A.
phrases.dit: Filter one, the form. After, will be, a base verb is impossible. Remove A.

phrases.texte: Filter two, the grammar. Implementing needs an object after it. There is none. Remove D.
Filter three, the meaning. A policy is not an implementation. Remove B.
Only C is left: the new policy will be implemented next month.
Manage your time. In Part 5, spend about twenty seconds per question.
